public.name: Public Edition
public.target_audience: General consumers via Google Play & macOS Developer ID

device_pairing.method: QR code or manual 6-digit pin over local mDNS/TLS

file_transfer.method: Storage Access Framework + chunked streaming with SHA-256 validation

clipboard_sharing.method: Mac auto-send -> Android notification/Quick Settings; Android explicit share to Mac

screen_mirroring.method: Android MediaProjection API with prominent user consent per session

camera_as_webcam.method: CameraX H.264 stream to macOS CoreMediaIO virtual camera extension

photo_backup.method: WorkManager background sync from MediaStore to Mac target directory

remote_control.reason: Accessibility-based full control restricted by Google Play policy

scrcpy_mirroring.method: Bundled scrcpy server over ADB (USB or Wi-Fi TCP/IP)
scrcpy_mirroring.resolution: Up to native display resolution at 60fps

low_latency_input.method: Direct injection of keyboard and mouse events via ADB/scrcpy

seamless_clipboard_sync.method: ADB pasteboard query and keyevent injection
